text: "You took the complexity of Tableau and smashed it down to nothing." 15 minutes from setup to insights. On your machine, with Docker and your own coding agent. High-performance, AI-safe self-service analytics — one platform from warehouse to beautiful dashboard. 15 minutes from setup to insights. On your machine, with Docker and your own coding agent. Partition-aware routing to fast hot tiers and aggregate tables — sub-second answers, lower warehouse spend. Born at Netflix, ready for the world A governed semantic layer, beautiful self-service dashboards, agents grounded in live data, and the open OLAP engines that make it all fast. One system, four ways to put it to work. Beautiful by default dashboards and deep self service for everyone. Model by naming. Grain safe blending, five measure types, federated routing. Agents that ask broad questions and get correct answers, on a governed model. Bring any OLAP engine. Fast, cost effective, and swappable, with no lock in. A governed semantic layer fused with beautiful-by-default dashboards. Two YAML file types and a naming convention are the whole model. Your coding agent drafts it, strata audit validates it against the warehouse, and Git carries it to production. No view, explore, or cube to pick first. Every step is validated and previewed as you build, and a semantically invalid query is refused before it runs. Each fact is aggregated to the common grain and joined on conformed keys, never fact to fact. Strata cannot double count, and agents get a refusal instead of a wrong number. Every query is routed to the fastest engine that can answer it, with a fallback to the warehouse when filters fall outside the hot tier. Sub second for agents and dashboards, less load on the warehouse. Drop views in the order you want them read and the layout engine sizes, places, and colors them. Nobody touches a grid, and nothing ships ugly. Standard, Complex, Snapshot, and LOD measures, always computed at the right grain, plus segments that put a cohort beside the baseline in one view. Build an agent in the same editor you build a report in, with live measures and dimensions in its instructions. It inherits your row level security and stays scoped to what matters. Self serve usage went from a handful a week to hundreds. The architecture became Strata.
